SELECT fish_date_doy, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) anglers, count(*) n, sum(yt)/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls='day_1_5' AND fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 306
GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT fish_date_doy, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) anglers, count(*) n, sum(yt)/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE cls='three_quarter' AND fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 306
GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 5
